task: Convert any uploaded interior photo, including an image with a furniture, lighting or decor item already blended into the room, into a luxury vertical three-panel material moodboard. Extract realistic close-up details from the actual item and surrounding interior. Render absolutely no text.

input_references.layout_reference: Use the supplied three-panel moodboard reference ONLY for its equal stacked layout, photographic close-up scale and editorial composition. Ignore all text and decorative lines. Never copy its glass, upholstery, oak or colors unless these are visible in the source interior.
input_references.source_interior: Use the uploaded room or blended interior image as the source of materials, colors, finishes and object details. If it is the only image supplied, apply the three-panel layout described here.
input_references.featured_item: Prioritize the furniture, lighting or decor item identified by the user or a separate supplied product reference. When no item is identified, select the most visually prominent furniture or lighting piece. Do not assume you can identify which object was digitally blended.
input_references.optional_product_reference: If a separate product photo is supplied, use it to preserve the featured item design and surface details; use the interior image for lighting and surrounding material choices.

material_selection.method: Inspect the featured item and room before choosing three material details. Include at least one close-up of the featured item. Choose remaining details from the item or visible surrounding furnishings and surfaces to form a coherent palette.
material_selection.adaptability: Adapt to any visible item, including a sofa, chair, table, cabinet, bed, chandelier, lamp or decor object. Materials may include fabric, leather, wood, metal, glass, stone, ceramic, rattan or other visibly supported finishes. Upholstery is not mandatory when none is visible.
material_selection.fidelity: Preserve visible colors, grain direction, weave, transparency, reflectivity, seams, curves and construction details. Do not redesign the item or invent unsupported materials.
material_selection.fallback: Prefer three distinct visible materials. If fewer than three are visible, use different close-up details or angles of the available materials rather than inventing new ones.

layout.arrangement: Three equal horizontal panels stacked vertically. Each occupies exactly one third of the image height and the entire image width.
layout.edges: Full bleed on all four canvas edges. Panels touch directly with clean straight boundaries. No borders, divider strokes, gutters, padding or outer margins.
layout.framing: Crop to fill each panel completely. Show photographic material details with natural object curvature and depth, like the reference. Do not recreate a full room, show an entire product, or include a source-image inset.

panels.top: A close-up of the most distinctive visible material or construction detail of the featured furniture, lighting or decor item.
panels.middle: A contrasting tactile detail from the featured item or surrounding furniture. Prefer visible upholstery or woven texture when available; otherwise choose another visibly supported surface.
panels.bottom: A complementary visible material from the item or interior, preferably distinct from the first two panels, to complete the palette.

photographic_style: Premium interior editorial macro photography, realistic tactile detail, gentle contrast, soft lighting consistent with the source image, natural shadows and believable reflections. Keep the selected surface in clear focus. Preserve the source color balance without adding an overly warm yellow or orange cast.

text_policy.instruction: The entire output must be text-free. Omit all reference labels and underlines. Do not render material names, titles, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, annotations or symbols. JSON keys and instructions are guidance only and must never appear in the image.

negative_prompt: Text, typography, material labels, titles, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, underlines, decorative lines, panel divider strokes, white borders, outer frames, margins, gaps, padding, letterboxing, source-photo insets, thumbnails, full-room views, whole-product catalog shots, flat color swatches, invented materials, redesigned furniture, copied reference materials absent from the source, excessive warmth, distorted details, smeared textures, people, unrelated objects, uneven panel heights.
final_check: Exactly three equal stacked full-bleed panels in 9:16.
No text or decorative lines anywhere.
At least one panel clearly derives from the featured item.
All selected materials are grounded in the uploaded source images.
